integrity_note: Proof, exact-rational executable tests, and the checker output are included; experiments complement rather than replace the analytic proof. The published underlying numerical method is credited to its original authors.
scientific_limitations: Exact results concern an undamped scalar harmonic oscillator, deterministic initial condition, additive scalar momentum noise, and the specified drift-preserving integrator. The weak-order statement is for polynomials of degree at most two and for fixed physical terminal time. An older related midpoint article was inaccessible in full, so a specialist precedence risk remains.
title: Exact covariance phase locking and stroboscopic weak-order recovery for a drift-preserving oscillator integrator
